title: スケジュール変更の判断
when: Decide whether to move a release, milestone or deadline date

steps.title: 遅延原因の復旧見込みを担当者に確認
steps.desc: Ask the owner of the blocking problem for a recovery estimate
steps.check: Does the situation mention a problem that is currently blocking progress?

steps.title: 現行日程に依存するチーム・顧客を確認
steps.desc: Check which teams or customers depend on the current date
steps.check: Could other teams or customers depend on the date being discussed?

steps.title: 選択肢（延期・スコープ縮小・現状維持）を比較
steps.desc: Compare the options: move the date, cut scope, or keep the date

steps.title: 日程を決定し記録
steps.desc: Make the date decision and record it

steps.title: 関係者へ変更を通知
steps.desc: Notify affected stakeholders of the decision
steps.check: Would a change of this date need to be communicated to people outside the immediate team?
